svg.title: FinGuard slide
svg.desc: FinGuard, HackNC 2026: an AI money agent that has to show its evidence before it acts. The problem, three principles, the request flow, measured results and live integrations.
svg.text: Agents that can pay bills also read scam texts and fake invoices,
and those words can steer where the money goes.
Money settlement is simulated on a ledger over live Nessie reads. No real money moves.
Trace every value to its source
Payee, account and amount must come from your
words or your bank's records. A value seen only in
The 4-digit code is bound to a SHA-256 hash of
the tool and its exact arguments. It expires in 2
Each event's hash covers the one before it, so an
edited or deleted event shows up as a break.
verify stops at #43, the first altered event
